text:
sara: heads-up: support saw duplicate provisioning calls during onboarding when a 429 hit at the same time as token refresh. not systemic but customer-facing. wondering if we can make sample apps safer by default.
tony: can you paste a tiny sanitized trace?
sara:
```
2026-04-08T12:03:21Z req=aoe12 status=429 retry-after=0.4
2026-04-08T12:03:21Z sdk retried req=aoe12 idempotency=none
2026-04-08T12:03:22Z server processed create_bucket idempotency=none
```
marlene: classic race. i propose three low-risk changes: 1) sample apps should enable an Idempotency-Key for mutating calls by default (opt-out), 2) SDKs add a short safe-replay-window default = 25s and use full-jitter exponential backoff honoring Retry-After, 3) emit a tiny, sparse retry context header only when retry logic runs so infra can correlate a sample of events.
tony: what does "retry context" look like? we need extremely low-cardinality, no PII.
marlene: suggestion: `X-Rw-Retry-Context: v=1;sdk=js;tag=auth-refresh;sample=1` where sample=1 is only present when the client decided to sample this occurrence. server stores only boolean+short tag for 7 days and can look up request_id. full payloads are never sent.
sara: example SDK snippet for sample apps:
```js
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = opts.idempotencyKey || uuidv4()
if (retryTriggered) {
  if (shouldSample(retrySampleRate)) headers['X-Rw-Retry-Context'] = 'v=1;sdk=node;tag=auth-refresh;sample=1'
}
await retryWithBackoff({baseMs:200, maxMs:30000, jitter:'full', honorRetryAfter:true, safeReplayWindowMs:25000})
```
tony: parity note: Node/Python/Go should expose configs: {autoIdempotency: bool, safeReplayWindowMs: number, retrySampleRate: float, honorRetryAfter: bool}. streaming/generation endpoints explicitly opt-out of auto-idempotency in docs.
marlene: infra ask: accept and index boolean+short tag from `X-Rw-Retry-Context` pre-scrub; keep for short retention; ensure policy prevents any payload data being captured.
ci-bot: created issue devex-2310: "retry-context sparse sampling + SDK safe-replay defaults" (assignee: @marlene) :spiral_note_pad:
sara: once RFC is up can we roll small sample-app PRs to demonstrate flags and reduce support noise?
tony: yes, and include a compatibility plan: servers treat absent idempotency as legacy/no guarantee. RFC should include privacy checklist and quick test plan.
marlene: i'll own the RFC and ping eng-runtime about pre-scrub indexing. thanks all. :thumbsup:
